Lena Ortiz: Pushed a fresh draft of the product launch post here: https://drive.redwood/marketing/launch-spring26-draft
Victor Huang: quick pass 0: need a tighter hero claim + explicit bench methods link. Also confirm which CTA goes to webinar vs full methods.
Maya Singh: For hero subline suggestion: 'Real-world docs search tests (mosaic-13b, 2026-03-18) show up to 46% lower per-query cost when caching is enabled.' Keeps it specific.
Evan J: pulling numbers from the bench run now. From run 2026-03-18: workload=docs-search, model=mosaic-13b, batch=16, quantized; cost reduction = 46% vs open baseline; p50 latency = 110ms. Use that in bench section.
Victor Huang: thanks Evan. Let's add an asterisk in the hero linking to methods: '*See methods for models, batch sizes, and hardware.'
Maya Singh: CTA copy proposal: primary = 'Explore benchmarks & register', secondary = 'Read full methods'. Primary should link to the webinar landing with UTMs.
Lena Ortiz: UTM pattern ops-friendly: campaign=redwood-launch-spring26, source=blog, medium=organic, content=hero-register|bench-methods. Example hero link: `?utm_campaign=redwood-launch-spring26&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_content=hero-register`
Victor Huang: inbound routing for webinar registrants -> SDR_APAC for first 48h when region_hint in ["APAC","AU","NZ"], otherwise -> SDR_Global. After 48h, forward to SDR_Backlog. Ops: can we ensure the lead gets a lead_ttl_hours tag?
IntegrationsBot: webhook schema validated. Required fields present: email, first_name, utm_campaign, utm_content, region_hint, lead_ttl_hours. Sample payload validated:
```
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "first_name": "{{first_name}}",
  "utm_campaign": "redwood-launch-spring26",
  "utm_content": "hero-register",
  "region_hint": "{{region_hint}}",
  "lead_ttl_hours": "48"
}
```
LegalBot: redline: replace any instance of 'guarantee' with 'aims to' and swap 'best' for 'validated in our tests'. Also remove any customer-identifying statements unless we have permission.
Maya Singh: noted. Accessibility: hero chart alt text: 'Cost and latency comparison for mosaic-13b on docs-search workload (A100-40GB)'; ensure color palette is colorblind-friendly.
Lena Ortiz: timeline: I need final copy + assets by 18:00 PT today to hit staging by 21:30 PT. Can folks do a final read and confirm here?
Evan J: I'll update the bench section with the exact run sentence and methods anchor by 15:30 PT.
Victor Huang: I'll finalize the UTM CSV and drop in #ops by 16:00 PT.
Maya Singh: I'll apply legal redlines and run a quick accessibility pass; will confirm by 17:30 PT.
Lena Ortiz: Awesome. If all green we'll lock the draft and schedule the staging publish. Leaving this thread open for any final microcopy or asset notes. :sparkles:
